## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem and what changes. Link the relevant issue or roadmap item.

## Validation

List meaningful checks and their results. Distinguish simulated tests from physical hardware tests. Include UI images for layout changes.

## Compatibility and remaining limits

State affected readers, firmware, boards and operating systems. Note any dependency, data-format, recovery or documentation changes.

- [ ] Routine tests do not open USB or program a cartridge.
- [ ] Support documentation matches the evidence; no new hardware qualification is implied by simulation alone.
- [ ] No ROMs, saves, generated files, personal data or unrelated work are included.
